name: A · Muted palette
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. One original Rogue Emblem archer map sprite, using attached sprite as identity and coarse-pixel reference. Keep older dark-brown-skinned gray-haired male archer, blue cloth, cream sleeves, brown leather, large near-white bow clearly separated from torso. Full body isolated on true transparent background. This must look like a nearest-neighbor enlargement of approximately 32x36 logical pixels: broad connected square color clusters, minimal shading, no micro-detail, antialiasing, gradients, ground, base, text or shadows. Preserve recognition at 34 pixels tall. PALETTE experiment: preserve original compact big-head proportions and upright relaxed pose as closely as possible. Replace electric cobalt with moderately desaturated STEEL BLUE midtone, slate-blue shadows. Keep ivory bow, cream sleeve and gray hair bright. Two shades per material. Do not darken skin. Mature restrained medieval palette, avoid all-navy darkness.
